title: Choose a small software product for a solo student developer to launch
audience: Students, freelancers, and small online businesses with recurring software or workflow needs
domain: Low-cost software workflows and online business operations suitable for a solo TypeScript developer
observations: The developer has strong TypeScript skills, about 10 hours per week, and a six-week target. Research should inspect recent credible sources, existing products, and direct user complaints for evidence of demand and plausible first customers.
offLimits: Products that cannot reach a realistic paid launch or validated MVP within six weeks at about 10 hours per week
